title: run controller test no longer depends on board commit timing
goal: test_runs_on_different_projects_run_at_the_same_time in tests/test_run_controller.py passes regardless of commit timing. Today controller._start starts claude before it writes the run record and makes its 'started' commit, so the fake orchestrator's 'board commit -m note' can carry the run record first and the 'run <id>: started; claimed …' message never appears (CI run 35731814395 on PR 58; a similar race on main at b2619f1, run 35728248322). Either the 'started' commit is made before claude can write the board, or the test checks the run record rather than the commit message.
